full_judgment: 12. This time limitation in concluding a criminal trial is something totally new. it is provided by addition to the original Code of Criminal Procedure we have inherited from the British days. Section 339 of the Code of Criminal Procedure as it originally stood concerned only with an approver, his pardon and forfeiture of that pardon. Subsequently a new Sub-section was inserted to that section as 339 B in December 1982 which provided for trial of an accused in absentia which kind of trial previously was also unknown and a nullity.
